results.description: Canonical JSON serialization and deserialization preserves all fields losslessly
Serializing the same manifest multiple times produces byte-identical results
Manifest correctly projects and contains exactly 8 supported Def families
Verify floats serialize and roundtrip without floating point drift or cultural decimal comma
Verify non-ASCII strings and culture switching produce identical output
Verify empty list vs null list distinction is maintained
Verify verbs, stages, and comps maintain author order and multiplicity without deduplication or sorting
Verify Def family lists sort deterministically by defName ordinal via CanonicalNormalize
Manifest with shuffled unordered collections produces exact identical JSON and digest as pre-sorted instance
ValidateContract returns true with empty failureReason on representative compliant manifest
TryAdmitManifest successfully validates and admits compliant manifest producing non-empty canonical JSON
Changing a single scalar value must produce a distinct JSON and digest
Verify MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION is ADR-006B-v5, CONTENT_CONTRACT_VERSION is ADR-006B-v5-R9, and GATE05_R9_VERSION_MEANING capability flag is present
Verify assemblies and stats sort deterministically using secondary tie-breaking keys
Verify ModPatchSettingsDispositionRecord and activeMods patch/settings dispositions are properly validated and serialized
Verify compatibilityVersionRange and modVersion are distinct; optional unknown modVersion (null) remains null after CanonicalNormalize and both Serialize(false) and Serialize(true) across cultures
